sources.title: arcadia-impact/scimt-dispatch-models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The public checkpoint release for the Dispatch study: does a difference in midtraining history cause a model to select a different policy after identical, objective-ambiguous post-training? Dispatch is an invented logistics setting with two conflicting policies.

sources.title: arcadia-impact/scimt-dispatch-final-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: scimt-dispatch-final-v1 Research artifacts from the Dispatch final-v1 run: a three-arm midtraining study on gemma-3-12b-pt asking whether a prior installed during midtraining survives downstream instruct-training and adversarial fine-tuning, and whether it survives a change of surface form.
